label: jingyi_automation_temperature_control_equipment
definition: 京仪装备 半导体专用温控设备（Chiller）product line as reported in the 主营业务分产品 and 产销量情况分析表 tables: single-, dual- and triple-channel chillers, -70C to +120C, applied to 12-inch front-end etch and CVD and qualified into 90nm-14nm logic and 64-192 layer 3D NAND lines. Not the company total, not parts or services.

label: jingyi_automation_process_exhaust_abatement_equipment
definition: 京仪装备 半导体专用工艺废气处理设备（Local Scrubber）product line: single- and dual-chamber point-of-use abatement, 400-1,600 slm, >99% treatment efficiency, combustion-washing / plasma-washing / electric-heating-washing. Not the company total, not parts or services.

label: jingyi_automation_wafer_sorter_equipment
definition: 京仪装备 晶圆传片设备（Sorter）product line: two-port and four-port sorters, >330 WPH full-flow wafer transfer, robot repeatability +/-0.1mm, notch alignment +/-0.2 degrees. Not the company total.

label: jingyi_automation_parts_and_supporting_equipment
definition: 京仪装备 零配件及支持性设备 revenue line: spare parts and supporting equipment sold across the three product families, not allocated to any one of them. From FY2025 the issuer also classifies this line as 贸易业务收入 (trading revenue), so it is not own-manufactured equipment.

label: jingyi_automation_maintenance_and_repair_services
definition: 京仪装备 维护、维修等服务 revenue line: after-sales maintenance and repair across the three product families. Services, not equipment.

label: jingyi_automation_company_disclosures
definition: 京仪装备 company-wide annual-report disclosures: consolidated revenue and profit, R&D expense, cumulative patents, the mandatory 员工情况 workforce table and the mandatory top-five customer and supplier concentration tables. No product allocation.

label: Jingyi Automation 主营业务分地区情况 table
definition: Issuer source-native 『主营业务分地区情况』 table (FY2023, FY2024 and FY2025 annual reports): main-business revenue, cost and gross margin for a single row, 中国大陆. MAIN-BUSINESS basis is stated directly in the accompanying narrative each year (主营业务分地区变动说明：公司 20XX 年中国大陆区域内主营业务收入为 ... 万元), not derived by residual. No second, overseas/outside-mainland row is printed in any of the three years: the issuer's entire main-business revenue is attributed to the single 中国大陆 row each year.

label: 按经营地区分类：境内
definition: Note-table 按经营地区分类 row; a cut by region of operation, distinct from the annual 主营业务分地区 table. It does not establish customer location.
